name: Lemon garlic chicken traybake
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C.
Halve the potatoes and cut the carrots into thick batons. Toss with two thirds of the oil, salt and pepper on a large tray.
Nestle the chicken thighs skin-side up among the vegetables. Tuck in the garlic and lemon quarters and brush the chicken with the remaining oil.
Roast 40 minutes, until the chicken skin is dark and the potatoes are crisp at the edges.
Squeeze the roasted lemon over everything and scatter with parsley.

name: Butternut squash and chickpea curry
steps: Soften the onion in the oil over medium heat, 8 minutes.
Add the garlic, ginger and curry powder and fry 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the squash, chickpeas and coconut milk. Simmer covered 20 minutes, until the squash yields to a knife.
Stir through the spinach until it collapses. Season and serve.

name: Beef and broccoli stir fry
steps: Start the rice.
Brown the beef hard in a very hot pan, breaking it up, 5 minutes. Remove.
Add the broccoli and peppers with a splash of water; cover and steam 3 minutes.
Return the beef, add garlic, ginger and soy sauce, and toss 2 minutes. Serve over rice.

name: Red lentil bolognese
steps: Sweat the onion, carrot and garlic in the oil over low heat, 10 minutes.
Add the lentils and tomatoes, plus a can of water. Simmer 25 minutes, until the lentils have gone soft and the sauce is thick.
Cook the pasta. Toss with the sauce and finish with parmesan.

name: Mushroom and kale risotto
steps: Fry the mushrooms in a dry pan until they squeak and brown. Set aside.
Soften the onion and garlic in the oil, then add the rice and toast 2 minutes.
Add hot stock a ladle at a time, stirring, until the rice is just tender — about 20 minutes.
Fold through the mushrooms, kale and parmesan. Rest 2 minutes before serving.

name: Roast salmon with summer vegetables
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Roast the potatoes in the oil for 15 minutes.
Add the zucchini and peppers, lay the salmon on top, and squeeze over half the lemon.
Roast a further 12 minutes, until the salmon flakes.
Finish with parsley and the remaining lemon.

name: Greek salad bowl
steps: Combine the cucumber, tomatoes and lettuce.
Dress with oil, lemon and plenty of pepper, then crumble the feta over the top.

name: Kale and chickpea salad with tahini
steps: Whisk the tahini, lemon juice, garlic and oil with a splash of water into a pourable dressing.
Massage the dressing into the kale with your hands until it softens and darkens, about a minute.
Fold in the chickpeas and feta. Better after twenty minutes in the fridge.

name: White bean and tomato soup
steps: Soften the onion and garlic in the oil, then stir in the paprika.
Add the tomatoes, beans and stock. Simmer 20 minutes.
Crush some of the beans against the side of the pot to thicken, then stir in the kale for the last 3 minutes.

name: Spinach scramble on toast
steps: Wilt the spinach in the oil over low heat, then pour in the beaten eggs.
Stir slowly and take the pan off the heat while the eggs still look underdone.
Pile onto toast and grind over black pepper.

name: Black bean and pepper wraps
steps: Fry the peppers hard in the oil until they take on colour, then add the beans and cumin and crush lightly.
Warm the tortillas.
Fill with the bean mixture, lettuce and yogurt loosened with lemon juice.

name: Hummus with vegetable sticks
steps: Blend the chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, garlic and oil with a few tablespoons of cold water until properly smooth.
Serve with the vegetable sticks.

name: Smoky roasted chickpeas
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C.
Toss the chickpeas with oil, paprika and salt and spread out on a tray.
Roast 30 minutes, shaking twice, until they rattle. They crisp further as they cool.

name: Apple with peanut butter
steps: Slice the apples and serve with the peanut butter for dipping.

name: Yogurt with blueberries and toasted oats
steps: Toast the oats in a dry pan until they smell nutty, 4 minutes. Cool.
Layer with the yogurt and blueberries.

name: Cherry tomato and basil spaghetti
steps: Bring a large pot of well-salted water to the boil and start the spaghetti.
Meanwhile warm the oil in a wide pan over medium heat. Add the garlic and chili flakes and cook 1 minute, until fragrant but not coloured.
Add the tomatoes and a pinch of salt. Cook 10-12 minutes, pressing them with a spoon, until they collapse into a loose sauce.
Drain the pasta, keeping a mug of the water. Toss the pasta through the sauce with a splash of the water until it clings.
Off the heat, fold through the basil and most of the parmesan. Season and serve with the rest on top.

name: Pesto pasta with green beans and potatoes
steps: Boil the potatoes in a large pot of salted water for 5 minutes.
Add the pasta to the same pot. Four minutes before the pasta is done, add the green beans.
Drain, keeping a mug of the water. Return everything to the pot off the heat.
Stir through the pesto with enough of the cooking water to make it glossy rather than claggy.
Season, and finish with the parmesan.

name: Garlic mushroom pasta
steps: Cook the pasta in well-salted water.
Get a wide pan properly hot with the oil. Add the mushrooms in one layer and leave them alone for 4 minutes so they brown rather than steam.
Stir, cook another 4 minutes, then add the butter, garlic and thyme leaves for a final minute.
Add the cream and a ladle of pasta water, then the drained pasta and the parmesan. Toss until it coats.
Season well and finish with parsley.

name: Lemon ricotta pasta with peas
steps: Cook the pasta, adding the peas for the last 2 minutes.
While it cooks, beat the ricotta with the lemon zest and juice, the oil and a good grind of pepper until smooth.
Drain, keeping a mug of water. Toss the pasta and peas through the ricotta with enough water to make a sauce.
Fold in the mint and parmesan, season, and serve straight away.

name: Pasta e ceci
steps: Soften the onion and celery in the oil for 8 minutes. Add the garlic, rosemary and chili flakes for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes and half the chickpeas. Crush the rest with a fork and add them too — they are what makes the broth creamy.
Pour in the stock, season, and simmer 10 minutes.
Add the pasta and cook until just tender, 8-10 minutes, stirring so it does not catch.
Rest 5 minutes off the heat. It should be thick enough to eat with a fork.

name: Eggplant and tomato pasta
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C. Toss the eggplant with half the oil and plenty of salt and roast 25 minutes, until collapsing and golden.
Meanwhile fry the garlic in the remaining oil for a minute, add the tomatoes, season, and simmer 15 minutes.
Cook the pasta in salted water.
Fold the roasted eggplant into the sauce, then the drained pasta with a splash of its water.
Serve with spoonfuls of ricotta and torn basil.

name: Roasted vegetable pasta with feta
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C. Spread the vegetables and garlic on a large tray, toss with the oil, oregano, salt and pepper.
Sit the block of feta in the middle and roast 30 minutes.
Cook the pasta in the last 10 minutes.
Crush the roasted feta and vegetables together on the tray to make a rough sauce.
Fold through the drained pasta with a splash of pasta water.

name: Three bean chili
steps: Soften the onion and peppers in the oil over medium-high heat, 8 minutes.
Add the garlic and all the spices and stir for a minute until they smell toasted.
Add the tomatoes, beans, stock and salt. Bring to the boil, then simmer 25 minutes, stirring now and then.
Taste and adjust the salt — chili needs more than you think.
Serve topped with cilantro, and sour cream if you like.

name: Black bean and sweet potato tacos
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C. Toss the sweet potato with the oil, cumin, paprika, chili powder and salt, and roast 25 minutes.
Squeeze one lime over the sliced red onion with a pinch of salt and leave it to soften while everything else cooks.
Add the drained beans to the tray for the last 5 minutes to warm through.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan, 20 seconds a side.
Fill with the sweet potato and beans, then the pickled onion, avocado, cilantro and a squeeze of the second lime.

name: Black bean burrito bowl
steps: Cook the rice. When it is done, fork through the lime juice, half the cilantro and a pinch of salt.
Warm the beans with the oil, cumin and a splash of water until they are hot and a little saucy, 5 minutes.
Heat the corn through in the same pan for the last 2 minutes.
Build the bowls: rice, beans and corn, then lettuce, salsa, avocado and cheese.
Finish with the rest of the cilantro.

name: Black bean burgers
steps: Mash the beans roughly with a fork — leave a third of them whole or the burgers turn to paste.
Mix in the breadcrumbs, egg, onion, garlic, spices, salt and pepper. Shape into four patties and chill 10 minutes if you have time.
Fry in the oil over medium heat, 5 minutes a side, until a firm crust forms. Move them as little as possible.
Toast the muffins in the same pan.
Build with lettuce, tomato and mayonnaise.

name: Bean and vegetable enchilada bake
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Fry the onion, peppers and zucchini in the oil for 8 minutes.
Add the spices and salt, stir for a minute, then the beans and half the passata. Take off the heat.
Spread a little of the remaining passata in a baking dish. Layer torn tortillas, filling and sauce twice over, finishing with sauce.
Scatter the cheese and bake 25 minutes, until bubbling at the edges.
Rest 5 minutes before cutting, and scatter with cilantro.

name: Chana masala
steps: Fry the onion in the oil over medium-high heat for 10 minutes, until properly browned at the edges. This is most of the flavour.
Add the garlic and ginger for a minute, then the cumin, coriander and turmeric for 30 seconds.
Add the tomatoes and salt and cook 5 minutes, until the oil separates out at the edges.
Add the chickpeas and a splash of water. Simmer 15 minutes, mashing a few against the side to thicken it.
Off the heat, stir in the garam masala, lemon juice and cilantro. Serve with naan.

name: Red lentil dal with tempered spices
steps: Simmer the lentils with the turmeric and 1 litre of water for 20 minutes, until they collapse. Skim any foam. Season with the salt.
Start the rice.
In a small pan, fry the onion in the butter for 8 minutes, then add the garlic, ginger, cumin and chili flakes for a minute.
Add the tomatoes and cook 4 minutes until soft.
Pour the whole lot into the lentils, stir in the garam masala, and serve over rice with cilantro.

name: Spinach and paneer curry
steps: Brown the paneer cubes in a third of the oil over high heat until golden on two sides. Lift out and set aside.
In the same pan, soften the onion in the rest of the oil for 8 minutes, then add the garlic, ginger and ground spices for a minute.
Squeeze the water out of the spinach and add it with a splash of water. Cook 5 minutes.
Blitz or chop roughly, return to the pan, and stir in the cream, garam masala and salt.
Fold the paneer back in, warm through, and serve with naan.

name: Paneer tikka tray bake
steps: Heat the oven to 230°C.
Mix the yogurt with the spices, garlic, ginger, oil, salt and the juice of half the lemon.
Turn the paneer, peppers and onion through the marinade until everything is coated.
Spread on a tray in one layer and roast 25 minutes, until charred at the edges.
Squeeze over the rest of the lemon, scatter with cilantro, and serve with warm naan.

name: Coconut chickpea and spinach curry
steps: Start the rice.
Soften the onion in the oil for 6 minutes. Add the garlic, ginger and curry powder and stir for a minute.
Add the chickpeas and coconut milk, season, and simmer 12 minutes until it thickens.
Stir the spinach through in handfuls until it wilts.
Finish with lime juice and serve over the rice.

name: Cauliflower and potato curry
steps: Soften the onion in the oil for 6 minutes, then add the garlic, ginger and spices for a minute.
Add the tomatoes, potatoes, chickpeas, salt and 300 ml water. Simmer covered for 12 minutes.
Add the cauliflower and cook another 10 minutes, until a knife slides into the potato.
Stir in the peas for the last 2 minutes.
Scatter with cilantro and serve with naan.

name: West African style sweet potato peanut stew
steps: Start the rice.
Soften the onion in the oil for 6 minutes, then add the garlic, ginger, cumin and chili flakes.
Add the tomatoes, sweet potato and stock. Simmer 20 minutes, until the potato is tender.
Whisk a ladle of the hot broth into the peanut butter to loosen it, then stir it back into the pot.
Add the kale and cook 5 minutes more. Season and serve over rice.

name: Thai red curry with tofu and vegetables
steps: Start the rice.
Press the tofu dry and brown it in the oil over high heat until crisp on several sides. Lift out.
Fry the curry paste in the same pan for a minute, until it smells strong.
Add the coconut milk, soy sauce and sugar, bring to a simmer, then add the peppers and beans for 6 minutes.
Return the tofu, warm through, and finish with lime juice and basil. Serve over rice.

name: Tofu, broccoli and cashew stir-fry
steps: Start the rice. Press the tofu dry between paper towels while it cooks.
Mix the soy sauce, vinegar, honey, cornstarch and 60 ml water into a sauce.
Brown the tofu in the vegetable oil over high heat, 6-8 minutes, turning until crisp. Lift out.
Add the broccoli and a splash of water, cover, and steam-fry 3 minutes. Add the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Return the tofu, pour in the sauce, and toss until it thickens and coats. Finish with cashews, sesame oil and green onions.

name: Vegetable fried rice
steps: Cold rice is the whole trick — yesterday's is ideal, and freshly cooked rice spread on a tray to cool for 20 minutes will do.
Scramble the eggs in a little of the oil until just set, then tip them out.
Get the pan very hot with the rest of the oil. Fry the carrot for 3 minutes, then the garlic and white parts of the green onion.
Add the rice and press it into the pan, letting it sit for a minute at a time so it toasts. Add the peas.
Return the egg, add the soy sauce and sesame oil, toss hard, and finish with the green onion tops and pepper.

name: Peanut noodles with tofu
steps: Soak or boil the noodles as the packet says, then rinse under cold water so they stop cooking.
Brown the tofu in the vegetable oil over high heat until crisp.
Whisk the peanut butter with the soy sauce, vinegar, honey, sesame oil, ginger, garlic, sriracha and 80 ml hot water until pourable.
Toss the noodles through the sauce with the carrot and cucumber.
Top with the tofu, green onions and cilantro.

name: Miso noodle soup with tofu and greens
steps: Bring the stock to a simmer with the ginger and mushrooms. Cook 6 minutes.
Add the bok choy and tofu and cook 3 minutes more.
Cook the noodles separately and divide between bowls.
Take the broth off the boil. Whisk the miso with a ladle of it in a cup, then stir it back in — boiled miso goes flat and grainy.
Add the soy sauce, ladle over the noodles, and finish with sesame oil and green onions.

name: Ginger bok choy and mushroom noodles
steps: Cook the noodles, drain and rinse.
Get a wide pan very hot with the vegetable oil. Fry the mushrooms without stirring for 3 minutes, then toss and cook 3 more.
Add the ginger, garlic and chili flakes for 30 seconds, then the bok choy stems for 2 minutes and the leaves for 1.
Add the noodles, soy sauce and vinegar and toss until everything is coated and hot.
Finish with sesame oil, sesame seeds and green onions.

name: Sticky tempeh noodle stir-fry
steps: Cook the noodles, drain and rinse.
Whisk the soy sauce, maple syrup, vinegar and sriracha together.
Fry the tempeh in the vegetable oil over medium-high heat, 3 minutes a side, until deep brown.
Add the cabbage and carrot and stir-fry 4 minutes, then the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Add the noodles and sauce and toss until sticky. Finish with sesame oil and green onions.

name: Halloumi tray bake with couscous
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C. Toss the vegetables with the oil, oregano, salt and pepper and roast 20 minutes.
Lay the halloumi over the top and roast another 8 minutes, until it is golden and the vegetables are blistered.
Meanwhile put the couscous in a bowl, pour over the boiling stock, cover, and leave 5 minutes. Fork it through.
Squeeze the lemon over the tray and scrape everything, juices included, over the couscous.
Finish with parsley.

name: Shakshuka
steps: Soften the onion and peppers in the oil in a wide pan for 10 minutes.
Add the garlic and spices for a minute, then the tomatoes and salt. Simmer 10 minutes until thick — a watery base will not hold the eggs.
Make six wells with the back of a spoon and crack an egg into each.
Cover and cook 6-8 minutes, until the whites are set and the yolks still loose.
Scatter with feta and parsley and serve with bread for scooping.

name: Chickpea patties with tahini sauce
steps: Blitz or finely chop the chickpeas with the garlic, parsley, onion, spices and salt. Stop while it is still coarse.
Work in the flour and shape into eight patties.
Fry in the oil over medium heat, 4 minutes a side, until deeply browned.
Whisk the tahini with the juice of the lemon and 4 tablespoons of cold water — it will seize, then loosen. Season.
Warm the pitas, fill with lettuce, tomato and patties, and spoon over the tahini sauce.

name: Bulgur pilaf with chickpeas and herbs
steps: Soften the onion and carrot in the oil for 8 minutes.
Add the garlic, spices and tomato paste and cook 2 minutes, until the paste darkens.
Stir in the bulgur and chickpeas, pour over the stock, season, and bring to the boil.
Cover, turn to the lowest heat, and cook 12 minutes. Rest off the heat 5 minutes, then fork through.
Fold in the herbs and lemon juice. Serve with yogurt.

name: Harissa roasted vegetables with couscous
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C. Toss the vegetables and chickpeas with the harissa, oil and salt.
Roast 30 minutes on a large tray, turning once, until the edges char.
Soak the couscous in the boiling stock, covered, for 5 minutes, then fork through.
Thin the yogurt with lemon juice and a pinch of salt.
Pile the vegetables over the couscous, spoon over the yogurt, and scatter with almonds and cilantro.

name: Peppers stuffed with rice, feta and herbs
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Sit the pepper halves cut side up in a baking dish.
Fry the onion in the oil for 6 minutes, add the garlic and oregano for a minute, then the tomatoes for 3.
Off the heat, fold in the rice, feta, pine nuts, parsley, salt and pepper.
Spoon the filling into the peppers, cover the dish with foil, and bake 20 minutes.
Uncover and bake 10 minutes more, until the tops colour.

name: Minestrone
steps: Soften the onion, carrot and celery in the oil for 10 minutes — do not rush this.
Add the garlic for a minute, then the tomatoes, stock, beans and salt. Simmer 15 minutes.
Add the pasta, zucchini and green beans and cook 10 minutes more.
Season generously. It needs more salt than most soups because of the pasta.
Serve with a spoonful of pesto stirred into each bowl and parmesan on top.

name: Spiced carrot and red lentil soup
steps: Soften the onion in the oil for 6 minutes, then add the garlic, ginger and spices for a minute.
Add the carrots, lentils and stock. Simmer 20 minutes, until the carrots give completely.
Blend until smooth, or leave it rough if you prefer.
Stir in the coconut milk and season.
Serve with cilantro and bread.

name: Potato and leek soup
steps: Sweat the leeks in the butter over low heat for 10 minutes with a pinch of salt, covered. Keep them pale.
Add the garlic, thyme and bay for a minute, then the potatoes and stock.
Simmer 18 minutes, until the potato is falling apart.
Fish out the bay and blend until smooth. Stir in the cream and season hard — potato soup needs it.
Serve with bread.

name: Mushroom and barley soup
steps: Brown the mushrooms hard in the oil in batches — crowded mushrooms steam, and the browning is the point.
Add the onion, carrot and celery and cook 8 minutes, then the garlic and thyme for a minute.
Add the barley, stock and soy sauce. Simmer 30 minutes, until the barley is tender but still has bite.
Season and add a splash of water if it has gone too thick.
Finish with parsley.

name: Butternut squash soup
steps: Soften the onion in the oil for 6 minutes, then add the garlic and spices.
Add the squash, carrot and stock. Simmer 25 minutes, until everything is soft.
Blend until completely smooth.
Stir in the coconut milk and season well.
Toast the pumpkin seeds in a dry pan and scatter on top. Serve with bread.

name: White bean and kale stew
steps: Soften the onion and carrot in the oil for 8 minutes. Add the garlic, rosemary and chili flakes.
Add the tomatoes, beans and stock, season, and simmer 12 minutes.
Mash a ladleful of the beans against the side of the pot and stir back in to thicken it.
Add the kale and cook 5 minutes more.
Serve with parmesan and bread.

name: Potato and spinach frittata
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C.
Fry the potato and onion in the oil in an ovenproof pan over medium heat, covered, for 12 minutes, until the potato is tender.
Add the garlic and the spinach and cook until the spinach wilts and any water has gone.
Beat the eggs with the salt and pepper and pour over. Scatter the feta on top.
Cook 2 minutes on the hob, then bake 12 minutes until just set. Rest 5 minutes before cutting.

name: Zucchini, mint and feta frittata
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Salt the grated zucchini in a sieve for 5 minutes, then squeeze it dry — this decides whether the frittata sets.
Fry the zucchini and green onions in the oil in an ovenproof pan for 5 minutes.
Beat the eggs with the mint, lemon zest and pepper and pour over. Dot with the feta.
Cook 2 minutes on the hob, then bake 12-15 minutes until just set in the middle.
Rest before cutting, and serve with bread.

name: Margherita pizza
steps: Heat the oven as high as it goes, 250°C or more, with a tray or stone inside.
Mix the passata with the garlic, oregano, salt and half the oil. Do not cook it.
Stretch each dough ball on a floured surface — push from the middle out and leave the rim alone.
Spread thinly with sauce, dot with mozzarella, and bake on the hot tray 8-10 minutes until blistered.
Finish with basil and the rest of the oil.

name: Pepper, olive and red onion pizza
steps: Heat the oven as high as it will go with a tray inside.
Season the passata with the oregano and salt.
Stretch the dough, spread thinly with sauce and top with mozzarella, peppers, onion, artichokes and olives.
Bake 8-10 minutes on the hot tray, until the base is crisp and the edges are dark in places.
Dress the arugula with the oil and pile it on as it comes out.

name: Squash and goat cheese flatbreads
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C. Toss the squash and onion with two thirds of the oil, the thyme leaves, salt and pepper, and roast 18 minutes.
Lay the pitas on a tray and pile the roasted squash and onion over them.
Dot with goat cheese and walnuts and bake 7 minutes, until the cheese softens and the bread crisps.
Drizzle with honey and the remaining oil.
Top with arugula and cut into wedges.

name: Mushroom stroganoff
steps: Start the rice.
Brown the mushrooms in the oil in a hot wide pan, in two batches so they colour. Set aside.
Soften the onion in the butter for 6 minutes, add the garlic and paprika for a minute.
Return the mushrooms with the stock and mustard and simmer 5 minutes.
Off the heat, stir in the sour cream — boiling it will split it. Season and serve over rice with parsley.

name: Roast cauliflower with white bean mash
steps: Heat the oven to 230°C. Brush the cauliflower slabs with half the oil, season, and dust with the paprika.
Roast 30 minutes, turning once, until deeply browned. Add the whole garlic cloves for the last 15 minutes.
Squash the roasted garlic into the beans with the stock and warm through, then mash roughly with the rest of the oil and the lemon juice.
Season the mash well — beans take a lot of salt.
Serve the cauliflower on the mash with parsley, almonds and chili flakes.

name: Ratatouille with garlic toast
steps: Fry the eggplant in half the oil over high heat until browned, then set aside. It cooks separately or it turns to mush.
Do the same with the zucchini, then the peppers and onion.
Return everything to the pan with the garlic, tomatoes, oregano and salt.
Simmer 20 minutes, uncovered, until thick and glossy.
Toast the bread, rub with a cut garlic clove, and serve alongside with basil torn over.

name: Butternut squash risotto
steps: Keep the stock at a bare simmer in a second pan.
Soften the onion in the oil for 6 minutes, then add the squash, garlic and thyme for 3 minutes.
Stir in the rice for a minute, until the grains look translucent at the edges.
Add the stock a ladle at a time, stirring, waiting for each to be absorbed. About 20 minutes.
Off the heat beat in the butter and parmesan, cover, and rest 2 minutes. Season and serve loose, not stiff.

name: Quinoa bowl with roasted vegetables and feta
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C. Toss the squash, onion and broccoli with three quarters of the oil, the cumin, salt and pepper.
Roast 30 minutes, turning once.
Rinse the quinoa and simmer in twice its volume of water for 15 minutes, then rest covered 5 minutes and fork through.
Whisk the lemon juice with the rest of the oil and a pinch of salt.
Toss the warm quinoa with the spinach so it just wilts, pile on the vegetables, and finish with feta, seeds and dressing.

name: Roasted roots with lentils and mustard dressing
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C. Toss the roots and onion with half the oil, the thyme, salt and pepper, and roast 33 minutes.
Simmer the lentils in plenty of water for 22 minutes, until tender but holding their shape. Drain and season while hot.
Whisk the mustard, vinegar and remaining oil into a dressing.
Fold half the dressing through the warm lentils and spread on a platter.
Pile the roasted vegetables on top with the goat cheese, walnuts and the rest of the dressing.

name: Kale, white bean and lemon pasta
steps: Toast the breadcrumbs in a dry pan until golden and set aside — they are the texture the dish would otherwise lack.
Cook the pasta, adding the kale for the last 3 minutes.
Gently fry the garlic and chili flakes in the oil, then add the beans and crush about a third of them.
Add the drained pasta and kale with a splash of the water and toss until creamy.
Finish with lemon juice, parmesan, the crumbs, salt and pepper.

name: Satay tofu and vegetable skewers with rice
steps: Start the rice. Heat the oven to 230°C or the grill to high.
Thread the tofu and vegetables onto skewers, brush with the oil, and roast or grill 20 minutes, turning halfway, until charred.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy sauce, lime juice, honey, ginger, sriracha and 80 ml hot water into a pourable sauce.
Spoon half the sauce over the hot skewers.
Serve on the rice with cilantro and the remaining sauce alongside.

name: Lemon roast potatoes with white beans and greens
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C. Toss the potatoes with the oil, oregano, garlic, the juice of one lemon, the stock, salt and pepper.
Roast 25 minutes, then stir in the beans and roast another 8, until the liquid has gone and the edges are crisp.
Fold the spinach through the hot tray so it wilts in the residual heat.
Crumble over the feta.
Cut the second lemon into wedges and squeeze over at the table.

name: Chickpea, cucumber and feta salad
steps: Soak the sliced onion in cold water for 5 minutes to take the edge off it, then drain.
Toss the chickpeas, cucumber, tomatoes and onion with the oil, lemon juice and oregano.
Fold through the feta and parsley and grind over the pepper.
It keeps a day in the fridge and is better after an hour.

name: Tabbouleh
steps: Cover the bulgur with 120 ml boiling water and leave 15 minutes, then fluff and cool.
This is a herb salad with grain in it, not the other way round — chop the parsley finely and use all of it.
Mix the bulgur with the herbs, tomatoes and green onions.
Dress with the oil, lemon juice, salt and pepper, and let it sit 10 minutes before eating.

name: Tomato, mozzarella and basil salad
steps: Salt the tomato slices and leave them 5 minutes — they will taste of more.
Layer the tomatoes and mozzarella on a plate with the basil tucked between.
Drizzle with the oil and vinegar and grind over pepper.
Serve with bread, which is there for the juices at the bottom.

name: Bread and tomato salad
steps: Toss the tomato chunks with the salt in a bowl and leave 10 minutes to draw out the juice.
Toast or griddle the torn bread until dry and lightly coloured.
Whisk the oil, vinegar and garlic into the tomato juices at the bottom of the bowl.
Add the bread, cucumber, onion and olives and turn everything over.
Leave 10 minutes so the bread softens without going to mush, then add the basil.

name: Beet, walnut and goat cheese salad
steps: Heat the oven to 210°C. Toss the beet wedges with half the oil and the salt and roast 30 minutes, until tender at the centre.
Whisk the vinegar, mustard, honey and the rest of the oil into a dressing.
Let the beets cool for a few minutes, then toss with half the dressing.
Pile onto the arugula with the walnuts and goat cheese and spoon over the rest.

name: Shaved Brussels sprout and apple salad
steps: Slice the sprouts as thinly as you can — this is the difference between a salad and a pile of raw cabbage.
Whisk the lemon juice, mustard, honey, oil, salt and pepper.
Toss the sprouts in the dressing and leave 10 minutes to soften.
Fold through the apple, parmesan and almonds just before eating.

name: Crunchy slaw with peanut dressing
steps: Whisk the peanut butter with the soy sauce, vinegar, honey, sesame oil, ginger and 3 tablespoons of warm water.
Toss the cabbage, carrot, pepper and green onions with the dressing.
Leave 10 minutes so the cabbage softens slightly.
Finish with cilantro and sesame seeds. It keeps two days.

name: Arugula and white bean salad
steps: Whisk the oil, lemon juice, garlic and chili flakes together.
Turn the beans through the dressing first and leave them 5 minutes — they take up more flavour than the leaves will.
Add the arugula, sun-dried tomatoes and onion and toss lightly.
Top with the parmesan and pepper.

name: Corn, avocado and black bean salad
steps: Whisk the lime juice, oil, cumin and salt in the bottom of a bowl.
Add the beans, corn, tomatoes and onion and turn them through.
Fold in the avocado last so it stays in pieces.
Finish with cilantro.

name: Garlicky chard and white beans on toast
steps: Fry the garlic and chili flakes gently in two thirds of the oil for 2 minutes.
Add the chard stems and cook 4 minutes, then the leaves with a splash of water until they collapse.
Add the beans and crush a few against the pan. Warm through and season.
Toast the bread, rub with a cut garlic clove and drizzle with the remaining oil.
Pile on the beans and chard, squeeze over the lemon, and grate over the parmesan.

name: Quinoa, apple and walnut salad
steps: Rinse the quinoa and simmer in twice its volume of water for 15 minutes. Rest covered 5 minutes, then fork through and cool.
Whisk the oil, vinegar, mustard, salt and pepper.
Toss the quinoa with the dressing while still warm.
Fold through the spinach, apple, walnuts, feta and parsley.

name: Peach, mozzarella and basil salad
steps: Use peaches that give slightly when pressed; hard ones are not worth doing this with.
Arrange the peach slices, mozzarella and arugula on a plate.
Drizzle with the oil and vinegar and season.
Scatter with basil and almonds.

name: Cold sesame noodle salad
steps: Cook the noodles, then rinse under cold water until completely cool.
Boil the edamame for 4 minutes and cool them too.
Whisk the tahini with the soy sauce, vinegar, sesame oil, honey and 3 tablespoons of water.
Toss everything together with the cucumber, carrot and green onions.
Finish with sesame seeds and chili flakes. Good cold from the fridge the next day.

name: Hummus and roasted pepper wrap
steps: Warm the tortillas briefly in a dry pan so they roll without cracking.
Spread each with hummus, leaving a clear border at the far edge.
Lay the peppers, cucumber, spinach, onion and feta along the near third.
Squeeze over the lemon, grind on pepper, and roll tightly, tucking the sides in.

name: Egg salad sandwich
steps: Lower the eggs into boiling water and cook 9 minutes, then cool them under cold running water.
Peel and chop roughly — egg salad wants texture, not paste.
Fold through the mayonnaise, mustard, green onions, dill, salt and plenty of pepper.
Pile onto two slices of bread, top with lettuce and the other slices, and cut.

name: Smashed avocado toast with a fried egg
steps: Toast the bread.
Smash the avocado with the lemon juice, salt and pepper. Leave it lumpy.
Fry the eggs in the oil, spooning the hot oil over the whites until they set and the edges frill.
Spread the avocado on the toast, add the tomatoes, and slide an egg on each.
Finish with chili flakes.

name: Mozzarella and tomato toastie
steps: Spread the pesto on the inside faces of the bread.
Layer the mozzarella and tomato between, with the basil and pepper.
Butter the outsides.
Cook in a dry pan over medium-low heat, pressed with a lid or a second pan, 4 minutes a side.
Low and slow is the point — high heat browns the bread before the cheese melts.

name: Mushroom and cheddar muffin melt
steps: Brown the mushrooms hard in the butter over high heat, 6 minutes, without crowding them.
Add the garlic and thyme for a minute and season.
Toast the muffin halves and spread each with a little mustard.
Pile on the mushrooms, cover with cheddar, and grill 3 minutes until it bubbles.

name: Asparagus and poached egg on toast
steps: Bring a wide pan of water to a bare simmer for the eggs.
Fry the asparagus in the oil over high heat for 4 minutes, until blistered but still with a snap.
Poach the eggs 3 minutes in the barely-moving water.
Toast and butter the bread, pile on the asparagus, and sit an egg on each.
Squeeze over the lemon and finish with parmesan, salt and pepper.

name: Corn, zucchini and cheddar quesadillas
steps: Fry the zucchini in the oil over high heat for 6 minutes, until it stops giving out water and browns.
Add the corn, garlic, cumin and salt for 2 minutes, then stir in the green onions and cilantro off the heat.
Spread over half of each tortilla, top with cheddar and fold.
Toast in a dry pan, 2-3 minutes a side, pressing down.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa.

name: Spiced chickpea pita pockets
steps: Fry the chickpeas in the oil over high heat for 6 minutes, pressing some flat so they blister.
Add the cumin, paprika and salt and toss for another minute.
Whisk the yogurt with the tahini, lemon juice and a splash of water.
Warm the pitas and open them up.
Fill with the chickpeas, cucumber, tomato and onion, and spoon in the sauce. Scatter with parsley.

name: Za'atar flatbread with halloumi
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Brush the pitas with half the oil, scatter over the za'atar, and bake 6 minutes.
Fry the halloumi in a dry hot pan, 2 minutes a side, until well browned.
Toss the tomatoes, cucumber, onion and parsley with the rest of the oil, the lemon juice and the salt.
Spread the flatbreads with hummus and top with the halloumi and salad.

name: Quick tomato soup
steps: Soften the onion and carrot in the oil for 8 minutes.
Add the garlic and oregano for a minute, then the tomatoes, stock and salt.
Simmer 20 minutes. A tomato soup that tastes thin has usually not been cooked long enough.
Blend smooth, stir in the cream if using, and season.
Serve with basil and bread.

name: Broccoli and cheddar soup
steps: Soften the onion in the butter for 6 minutes, then add the garlic.
Add the potato and stock and simmer 10 minutes.
Add the broccoli and cook 8 minutes more — longer and the colour goes.
Blend, then stir in the milk and mustard and season.
Take it off the heat before adding the cheddar, a handful at a time, or it will go grainy.

name: Chilled cucumber and yogurt soup
steps: Blend the cucumber, yogurt, herbs, garlic, lemon juice, salt and pepper until smooth.
Thin with cold water until it pours easily — it thickens as it chills.
Chill at least 30 minutes. Served warm it is dull; properly cold it is not.
Serve with the oil drizzled over, the walnuts scattered on top, and bread.

name: Sesame edamame rice bowl
steps: Cook the rice and let it cool a little.
Boil the edamame for 4 minutes and drain.
Whisk the soy sauce, vinegar, sesame oil and honey.
Divide the rice between two bowls and arrange the edamame, carrot, cucumber and avocado over it.
Spoon over the dressing and finish with sesame seeds and green onions.

name: Herbed couscous with halloumi
steps: Pour the boiling stock over the couscous, cover, and leave 5 minutes. Fork through with half the oil.
Fry the halloumi in a dry hot pan, 2 minutes a side.
Fold the herbs, green onions, cucumber and tomatoes into the couscous.
Dress with lemon juice, the rest of the oil, salt and pepper, and lay the halloumi over the top with the almonds.

name: Sweet potato and black bean hash with eggs
steps: Fry the sweet potato in the oil in a covered pan over medium-high heat for 12 minutes, stirring now and then.
Uncover, add the pepper and onion, and cook 5 minutes until browned at the edges.
Add the garlic, spices, salt and beans for 2 minutes.
Make two wells, crack in the eggs, cover, and cook 4 minutes until the whites set.
Top with avocado, cilantro and sriracha.

name: Whipped feta dip with pita
steps: Blend the feta, yogurt, garlic, lemon juice and half the oil until completely smooth. It takes longer than you expect.
Spread into a shallow bowl and pull a spoon through it to make ridges.
Drizzle with the rest of the oil and the honey, and scatter with chili flakes and pepper.
Warm and tear the pita to scoop.

name: Tzatziki with raw vegetables
steps: Salt the grated cucumber in a sieve for 10 minutes, then squeeze it hard. Skipping this gives you cucumber soup.
Stir it into the yogurt with the garlic, herbs, lemon juice, oil and a little more salt.
Chill 20 minutes if you can.
Serve with the carrot batons and radishes.

name: Guacamole with tortilla chips
steps: Mash the avocado with the lime juice and salt, leaving it chunky.
Fold in the onion, tomato, chili and cilantro.
Taste for salt and lime — it almost always wants more of both.
Serve with the chips, with the stone pressed back in if it has to wait.

name: Smoky paprika popcorn
steps: Heat the oil in a large pot with three kernels in it and the lid on.
When those three pop, add the rest, shake to coat, and put the lid back on slightly ajar.
Shake every few seconds until the pops slow to one every couple of seconds, then take it straight off the heat.
Toss immediately with the paprika, salt and parmesan while it is hot enough for them to stick.

name: Peanut butter oat balls
steps: Stir the peanut butter and honey together until smooth.
Mix in the oats, chia seeds, chocolate, cinnamon and salt. It should hold together when squeezed; add a spoonful of oats if it is sticky, a little more peanut butter if it crumbles.
Roll into about sixteen balls.
Chill 30 minutes to firm up. They keep a week in the fridge.

name: Berry chia pudding
steps: Whisk the chia seeds into the milk with the maple syrup.
Whisk again after 5 minutes — this is what stops it setting in one lump.
Cover and refrigerate at least 3 hours, or overnight.
Warm the berries briefly in a pan until they release their juice, and cool.
Layer the pudding with the yogurt and berries and top with almonds.

name: Banana and peanut butter rice cakes
steps: Spread the rice cakes with peanut butter.
Lay the banana slices over the top.
Scatter with chia seeds and cinnamon, and drizzle with honey if you want it sweeter.

name: Apple, cheddar and crackers
steps: Slice the apple just before eating, or squeeze a little lemon over it.
Arrange with the cheddar, crackers and walnuts.
A sharp cheddar and a tart apple is the whole point; a mild one of either disappears.

name: Dark chocolate almond clusters
steps: Toast the almonds in a dry pan for 4 minutes and let them cool.
Melt the chocolate in a bowl over a pan of barely simmering water, or in short bursts in the microwave, stirring between each.
Stir in the almonds and pumpkin seeds.
Spoon into twelve clusters on baking paper, sprinkle with salt, and chill 20 minutes to set.

name: Yogurt with honey and walnuts
steps: Spoon the yogurt into two bowls.
Toast the walnuts in a dry pan for 3 minutes — untoasted they taste of nothing much.
Drizzle over the honey, scatter the walnuts, and dust with cinnamon.

name: Cucumber and feta bites
steps: Lay the cucumber rounds out on a plate.
Mix the feta, tomato and olives with the oil and oregano.
Spoon a little onto each round and grind over pepper.

name: Tomato, mozzarella and basil skewers
steps: Thread a tomato, a folded basil leaf and a cube of mozzarella onto each small skewer or cocktail stick.
Lay them on a plate and drizzle with the oil and vinegar.
Season just before serving — salted early, the tomatoes weep.

name: Spiced roasted almonds
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C.
Toss the almonds with the oil, then the spices and salt.
Spread on a tray and roast 12 minutes, shaking once. They crisp further as they cool, so take them out while they still seem slightly soft.
Cool completely before storing; they keep two weeks in a jar.

name: Salted edamame
steps: Boil the edamame for 5 minutes, or steam them.
Drain well and toss straight away with the sesame oil so the seasoning sticks.
Scatter with the salt, sesame seeds and chili flakes and eat warm.

name: Frozen berry yogurt bark
steps: Line a tray with baking paper.
Stir the honey through the yogurt and spread it about 1 cm thick on the tray.
Scatter over the berries, pumpkin seeds and chocolate and press them in lightly.
Freeze 4 hours, then break into shards. Keep them in the freezer — it softens fast.

name: Mango with lime and chili
steps: Cut the mango into cubes and divide between two cups.
Squeeze over the lime.
Dust with the chili powder and salt — the salt is what makes the fruit taste sweeter, not less.
Add torn mint if you have it.

name: Pear and goat cheese crostini
steps: Cut the bread into smaller pieces, brush with the oil, and toast until crisp at the edges.
Spread each with goat cheese while still warm.
Lay the pear slices over and scatter with walnuts.
Drizzle with honey and grind over pepper.

name: Citrus and berry fruit salad
steps: Segment the oranges over the bowl so the juice goes in with them.
Add the strawberries and grapes.
Stir the honey into the lime juice until it dissolves, then pour it over and turn everything gently.
Add the mint at the last minute so it stays green.

name: Roasted rhubarb with yogurt
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C.
Lay the rhubarb in a single layer in a dish, scatter with the sugar, and add the orange zest and juice.
Cover with foil and roast 20 minutes, until tender but still holding its shape. Stirring it breaks it down, so do not.
Cool. It keeps five days in the fridge.
Spoon over the yogurt with the syrup from the dish, and top with granola.

name: Granola and jam yogurt jar
steps: Loosen the jam with a teaspoon of hot water so it ripples rather than sits in a lump.
Layer the yogurt, jam, blueberries and granola in two jars.
Scatter the chia seeds on top.
Add the granola at the last minute if you are making these the night before, or it goes soft.
